title: Homeowner-Plan Credit on Rental Upgrade Difference Charges
content:
**Credit rule.** A Rental Property Service Contracts upgrade difference charge carries a homeowner-plan credit read from the landlord's Bridgewell Homeowner Service Contracts holdings.

| The landlord's Homeowner Service Contracts holding | Credit |
|---|---|
| an active homeowner service contract billed annually | 0.03 |
| an active homeowner service contract billed monthly | 0.02 |
| otherwise | 0 |

**Records read.** From the Homeowner Service Contracts records: the landlord's homeowner service contract in status active and its billing frequency.

**How the credit acts.** Concessions and credits on an upgrade difference charge are subtracted from one and a loading is added, all in one sum, and the charge is multiplied once by that sum before its single rounding to the cent.

*Hypothetical:* an active homeowner service contract billed annually: 0.03; one in its waiting period: 0.
